messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 18):
"""
S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 3.9.3 How the Add-on will benefit the insured if taken along with this product 4 Underwriting -Selection of Risks [This section should discuss how the different segments of the population will be dealt with for the purpose of underwriting (to the extent they are relevant and a brief detail of procedure adopted for assessment of various risk classes may be given.) 4.1 Specify Non-medical Limit [Where no pre-medical examination is asked for] 4.2 Specify when and what classes of lives would be subject to medical examination 4.3 Whether any loading based on the health status are applicable Yes / No, if yes furnish the details of loadings: 4.4 Whether any loading based on the occupation are applicable Yes / No, if yes furnish the details of loadings:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Which classes of lives are required to undergo a medical examination under the underwriting guidelines of the IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business?","answer":"Lives that fall under the specified risk classes as per the insurer’s underwriting procedure must undergo a medical examination.","facts":["4.2 Specify when and what classes of lives would be subject to medical examination"]},{"question":"Are there any loadings applied based on an insured’s health status or occupation in the underwriting process?","answer":"Loadings may be applied based on health status and occupation, if the insurer chooses to do so, and the details of such loadings must be furnished.","facts":["4.3 Whether any loading based on the health status are applicable Yes / No, if yes furnish the details of loadings:","4.4 Whether any loading based on the occupation are applicable Yes / No, if yes furnish the details of loadings:"]}]}
